NF006719.0.notes: Unresolved acronym in the figure. It may denote an aspartate/aromatic amino-acid aminotransferase; organism, accession, and intended reaction are not specified. NF006719 is an aromatic amino acid transaminase subfamily profile cross-referenced by human and Drosophila aspartate aminotransferases; despite these cross-references, NCBI metadata lists Bacteria as its curated taxonomic range. All three are context-only candidates, NOT definitive calls of the unspecified host AAT. The unrelated bacterial aat tRNA-protein transferase was excluded.

operon_templates.notes: Projected trpE-(trpG/TrpD fusion)-(TrpC/TrpF fusion)-trpB-trpA. Standalone trpD/trpF are not independently assayed.
